name: c-trace-7
title: Support copilot draft
description: A drafted support reply with the order and policy lookups behind it, and Regenerate replaying them.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Trace, TraceCollapsible, TraceCollapsibleContent, TraceCollapsibleTrigger, TraceDescription, TraceIcon, TraceLine, TraceTitle, } from "@/components/ui/trace" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" type Lookup = { id: string pending: string running: string done: string finding: string href?: string icon: "order" | "truck" | "policy" } const LOOKUPS: Lookup[] = [ { id: "order", pending: "Look up order #48213", running: "Looking up order #48213", done: "Looked up order #48213", finding: "Shipped Oct 9", href: "#", icon: "order", }, { id: "carrier", pending: "Check carrier tracking for 1Z84F0", running: "Checking carrier tracking for 1Z84F0", done: "Checked carrier tracking for 1Z84F0", finding: "Held at Louisville hub", icon: "truck", }, { id: "policy", pending: "Read the late delivery policy", running: "Reading the late delivery policy", done: "Read the late delivery policy", finding: "Section 4.2", href: "#", icon: "policy", }, ] const DRAFTS = [ "Hi Dana, your order is held in Louisville until Friday. I've refunded your $12 shipping.", "Hi Dana, a carrier delay holds your order until Friday. Your $12 shipping is refunded.", ] // The lookups fold into one row and the draft opens in the row after them. export function Pattern() { const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(0) // Lookups finished in the current pass. Equal to LOOKUPS.length when idle. const [finished, setFinished] = React.useState(LOOKUPS.length) const [stepsOpen, setStepsOpen] = React.useState() const [inserted, setInserted] = React.useState(false) const busy = finished < LOOKUPS.length const statusRef = React.useRef(null) React.useEffect(() => { if (!busy) return const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setFinished((n) => n + 1), 700) return () => window.clearTimeout(timer) }, [busy, finished]) // Both buttons disable while a pass runs, so focus moves to the status line. function regenerate() { statusRef.current?.focus() setInserted(false) setStepsOpen(undefined) setFinished(0) setDraft((n) => (n + 1) % DRAFTS.length) } return (
{/* Open while the copilot works, folded once it is done, and the agent's own click wins either way. */} {busy ? "Checking the order" : "Checked the order and policy"} {busy ? `${finished} of ${LOOKUPS.length}` : `${LOOKUPS.length} lookups`} {LOOKUPS.map((lookup, index) => { const state = index < finished ? "done" : index === finished ? "running" : "pending" const line = ( {lookup[state]} {state === "done" ? ( {lookup.finding} ) : null} ) // Only a finished lookup with a record behind it links out. return state === "done" && lookup.href ? ( {line} ) : ( {line} ) })} {busy ? ( Draft a reply to Dana ) : ( Drafted a reply to Dana {/* The reply is what gets sent, so it reads at full contrast inside the muted panel. */}

{DRAFTS[draft]}

 )}

{busy ? "Drafting a new reply" : inserted ? "Added to the composer" : ""}

) } function DraftGlyph() { return ( ) } function LookupGlyph({ icon }: { icon: Lookup["icon"] }) { switch (icon) { case "order": return ( ) case "truck": return ( ) case "policy": return ( ) } }
